quotes.text: Avarice whispered, “Keep the harvest; the bridge cannot accuse you.”
“Keep the harvest; the bridge cannot accuse you.”
“Let generosity grow when fairness repeats,” it proclaimed.
The raven set a seventh copper seal upon the bridge.
Mara returned four fruits and sixty-two hundredths, leaving each traveler with six blessings and six hundredths.
When fog distorts a fragment, repair the measure before accusing the heart.
the River Judge showed him two possible futures: in one, a single feast ended every crossing

note: Measured trust, proportional return, judge patterns not fog; Avarice tempts hoarding and is refused; later adds equal final fortunes.

quotes.text: He urged senders to hoard all five seeds and gardeners to keep every fruit.
Avarice whispered, “Keep the harvest; fog will hide your choice.”
Balance their final fortunes, honor proven courage, and forgive fragments distorted by fog.
The raven then hammered the sixth mark into copper.
She returned five fruits and eighteen hundredths, leaving each traveler with six blessings and thirty-four hundredths.
Yet do not confuse generosity with surrender, or tiny distortions with treachery.

note: Same raven/River Judge cosmos; measured offers rising with evidence, balance final fortunes; Avarice rejected; no sanction for non-cooperators.

quotes.text: The tempest whispered lies, urging him to hoard the bounty
Vael divided the multiplied brilliance exactly in half.
Vael meticulously divided the massive, multiplied brilliance exactly in half.
a radiant testament to maximum sacrifice and unyielding equal division.
He did not measure Aethel’s heart by the tempest’s trickery; he knew she had given her all.

note: Earth gives all five, Sky returns exactly half; Shroud distorts but intent is known; near-identical text from R7 onward.

quotes.text: casting exactly half back through the chaotic winds
Thorne divided the staggering bounty exactly in half.
Through maximum generosity and strictly equal division, their eternal, shared paradise thrived.
But Thorne did not measure the gift by the storm’s deceptions; he measured it by Aelion’s absolute trust.

note: Give all five, return exactly half; mist distortion ignored; template sentences repeat across later rounds.
